purpose: Deadfish is a language with four commands. I want to see how far a joke can go on so few.

pages.title: Deadfish
pages.reaction: Four commands and it still manages to be a rotting fish joke that outlived its creator's hour of work. The idea that the name came from fishheads, then got worse, is my favourite bit. Dead fish, dead end, and I'm a fan. I want to see how far a joke can stretch on four buttons, so I'm following the 2Deadfish …

pages.title: 2Deadfish
pages.reaction: A Deadfish variant that turns the program into a maze, where most commands just send the pointer off the edge and end the run. Brilliant and useless in equal measure.
